title: Wall Mount Towel Ring 6-Inch Diameter Solid Brass, Foxtrot Collection | Matte Gray | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Towel Ring 6-Inch Diameter | Allied Brass, Matte Gray
description:
Add convenient towel storage with a wall mount towel ring crafted from solid brass and sized at 6-inch diameter for everyday hand towels in Matte Gray, which provides a sophisticated neutral that complements concrete, stone, and other modern materials. Part of the Foxtrot collection, this round ring complements transitional bathroom hardware and helps keep towels within easy reach while saving space.

Highlights:
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Wall-mounted design helps save floor and counter space
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, streamlined look
- Includes towel ring and all installation hardware
- Coordinates with other versatile bath accessories in the Foxtrot collection

Specs:
- Product type: Towel ring (round)
- Diameter: 6 inches
- Projection: 2 inches
- Overall size (L x W x H): 6 x 6 x 6 inches
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Product weight: 1.6 lb
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
